prerequisites: He has ordered knowledge about the types of engineering materials - metal, ceramic, polymer and composite materials.
It has a basic knowledge of the construction, operation and use of the main components and machine assemblies.
It has a basic knowledge of physics, chemistry, statistics.
It can analyze the macroscopic fractures, microstructure of materials, technological drawbacks of origin, is able to determine the characteristics of the microstructure of metallic materials.
He can choose the material on a given machine element and can explore its basic properties.
Is aware of the importance and understanding of non-technical aspects and impacts of mechanical engineer.
Is aware of the importance of behavior in a professional manner and have a sense of responsibility for their own work.

learning_outcomes.text: Has knowledge of the processes of friction, wear and lubrication of moving nodes machine.
Know the basic types of lubricants and their applications.
He knows the design and technological methods of increasing the reliability and durability of sliding pairs.
It can choose materials for sliding nodes and understand relationships and dependencies between the material used and its durability.
It can perform basic tests of materials used in the nodes of friction, interpret them and implement in the final node machines.
He can use the theoretical knowledge acquired friction and lubrication of the lecture and apply it in practice.
It can search for information and critically analyze them.
Properly define and resolve dilemmas, adheres to the principle of professional ethics.
Able to work independently and as a team, and properly assess their own tasks and priorities of the group.

syllabus_topics: Program and requirements. Brief history of tribology.
Elastic contact of smooth bodies. The real contact of solids. The problem of the surface layer.
Friction processes, their distribution and characteristics. Sliding and rolling friction. Theories of friction.
Wear processes, their distribution and characteristics. Effect of pressure and sliding velocity on the friction and wear.
Characteristics of materials (metal and others) on the sliding nodes and the rules for their selection. Simple and reversed pair of friction.
Susceptibility, stiffness and configuration elements as factors that increase the wear resistance.
Grease as a construction material. Objectives lubrication. The way of obtaining o fluid friction. Distribution of lubricants. Lubricating oils and their properties.
Greases, their distribution and characteristics.Their characteristics.
Determining of properties of slide bearing materials.
Determining of coefficient of static friction.
Research of lubricity of greases using a four ball tester.
Determination of the behavior of friction materials for brakes and and clutches.
Analysis of the impact bushing stiffness for load distribution in the sliding bearing.
Analysis of the impact on the structure of the material on abrasive wear (Tester T-07).
Research of the frictions into screw gear.
teaching_methods: traditional lecture with the use of transparencies and slides
self study - self studies and preparation for examination
self study - preparation for laboratory class

assessment_methods.method: quiz - entrance ticket, the report of the laboratory exercises, oral answer (Laboratory)

assessment_rules: For lectures, the final evaluation (P) is based on forming evaluations (F1), which include tests and quizzes. For laboratory classes, the final evaluation (P) is based on forming evaluations (F1), which include quizzes (entrance ticket), laboratory reports, and oral answers.
